summary: Frontend testing for football/futsal team management app latest changes. Tested: 9v9 format text on home page, MATCH MODE button on tactics screen, halftime-based duration selector, auto-sub equal play time display, match history with score/starting lineup. Found CRITICAL BUG: Formation switching causes players to disappear from pitch.

ui_bugs.issue: Formation switching causes most players to disappear from pitch. Only 1-3 players visible instead of 11. Root cause: useEffect initializes assignments using stale selectedFormation state.

test_2_match_mode_button.description: Tactics screen shows 'MATCH MODE' button (not 'START MATCH')

test_3_match_setup_screen.description: Match setup screen shows: MATCH MODE header, MINUTES PER HALF selector, total match time hint (e.g. '90 min (45 x 2 halves)'), START MATCH button

test_4_auto_sub_expected_playing_time.description: EXPECTED PLAYING TIME section shows bars for all players. GK gets full match time (90 min), outfield players get approximately equal time (~45 min each for rotation)

test_5_substitution_plan.description: SUBSTITUTION PLAN section shows rotation windows with minute markers

test_6_formation_switching.description: Formation switching causes players to disappear. Only 1-3 of 11 players remain visible after switching formations

test_7_9v9_format_selection.description: 9v9 format appears in format selection screen. Clicking navigates to team setup with 'FOOTBALL · 9v9' badge and 'SQUAD (0 / 9+ players)'

test_8_match_history.description: Match history shows: score (e.g. 4-3), starting lineup with player names/numbers, formation badges, chevron arrows, starters/subs/notes counts

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Formation switching causes players to disappear from pitch in tactics.tsx
Root cause: useEffect on line 54-66 initializes assignments using selectedFormation which may be stale
The setSelectedFormation(found) on line 57 updates state AFTER initialAssign is already calculated using old selectedFormation value
Solution: Add selectedFormation to useEffect dependency array OR move assignment initialization to a separate effect that runs after formation is set
critical_code_review_comments: tactics.tsx line 62: Uses selectedFormation state which may be stale in the useEffect with empty dependency array []
tactics.tsx line 77-102: changeFormation() relies on prev state which may have fewer players assigned than expected
The initial assignment only assigns players up to selectedFormation.positions.length, but if formation changes, this count is wrong
Consider using useCallback or splitting the useEffect to ensure formation is set before assignments are calculated
seed_data_creation: None - used existing teams 'Monolitten g2012' (11v11) and 'Monolitten' (futsal)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Formation switching bug confirmed. The issue is in tactics.tsx useEffect initialization. When you switch formations, only 1-3 players appear instead of 11. This affects the team 'Monolitten g2012' with 13 players. All other features (9v9 text, MATCH MODE button, halftime duration, auto-sub display, match history) work correctly.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Formation switching causes players to disappear from pitch
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In tactics.tsx, the useEffect on line 54-66 has an empty dependency array []. It uses selectedFormation state to calculate initialAssign, but selectedFormation may be updated by setSelectedFormation(found) on line 57 AFTER initialAssign is already calculated. The state update is asynchronous, so the old formation's position count is used.
reproduction_steps: 2. Click on team card (e.g. Monolitten g2012)
3. Observe initial formation shows some players
5. Players disappear - only 1-3 visible instead of 11
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Fix the useEffect to properly depend on selectedFormation or restructure to ensure formation is set before assignments are calculated
